selection: All 370 official validation images excluded from the frozen 80-image tuning subset. No overlap with previous 828-image experiment or archived FloodNet input/raw directories.
use: Additional evaluation only; no checkpoint, threshold, prompt, loss, or architecture tuning. Results reported separately from the 448 official test images.
candidates: Original head control; original LoRA selected by the 80-image validation score; best 80-image-validation candidate in each of the two night methods. Model selection uses validation only.
limitation: Single-event frame-level holdout; not geographic cross-event evidence or proof of absence from foundation-model pretraining.
